name: Amazon ONT8 Fulfillment Center Moreno Valley CA

fieldNotes.guardShack: Walled/fenced truck yard with a controlled pinch-point entrance off the north road (west perimeter drive throat ~33.8697,-117.2386); STOP striping and a small booth-footprint structure beside the inbound lane at the throat. Amazon FCs of this scale staff a guard booth at the inbound truck check-in. Backlit morning Street View partly obscures the booth, so flagged uncertain, but evidence supports guardShack:true over remote check-in.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Yard is screened by tilt-up concrete walls along the south and west streets and palisade fence on the east; the only truck-side opening is the controlled NW throat off the north road. Open driveway ruled out.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide entrance apron; estimated ~2 inbound lanes from overhead striping, low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and deep internal yard provide ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock FC: long dock-door rows on the building's north and south faces plus a detached south dock structure; honest overhead estimate ~180 doors total, well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on physically separate building faces (north and south), consistent with separated inbound/outbound flow.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved yard inside the gate (west perimeter drive + numbered trailer stalls 300+) holds queued trucks well before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Numbered trailer-storage stalls observed into the 300-365 range across north and south yards; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter polygon (~365m x ~402m secured property) ≈ 36 acres.
